title: Selected Security Control Catalogue
description: Metadata and framework mappings for the four security-control areas assessed by the proof-of-concept tool.
$comment: The mappings represent the documented interpretation adopted by this proof-of-concept. They do not constitute an official ISO/IEC–NIS2 crosswalk.

limitations: The catalogue covers only four selected security-control areas.
It does not represent complete coverage of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 or Directive (EU) 2022/2555.
The mappings support a preliminary assessment and must not be interpreted as certification, audit assurance, a legal compliance determination or legal advice.
The NIS2 titles stored in this catalogue are concise descriptive labels used by the project and are not official standalone titles assigned to the individual points of Article 21(2).

mfa.description: Assessment of whether multi-factor authentication is implemented for privileged accounts and remote access.
mfa.assessment_scope: The assessment focuses on the multi-factor authentication component of NIS2 Article 21(2)(j), rather than all secure-communication measures included in that point.

framework_mappings.title: Multi-factor or continuous authentication and secure communications

backup.description: Assessment of whether information backups are enabled, stored separately where appropriate and supported by restoration testing.
backup.assessment_scope: The assessment focuses on backup management and restoration testing within NIS2 Article 21(2)(c), rather than the complete areas of business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management.

framework_mappings.title: Business continuity, backup management, disaster recovery and crisis management

patch_management.description: Assessment of whether the organization defines a patch-management process, identifies technical vulnerabilities, reviews patch status and manages unsupported software.
patch_management.assessment_scope: The assessment focuses on vulnerability handling, patch management and unsupported software within NIS2 Article 21(2)(e). It does not assess the complete system acquisition, development and maintenance lifecycle.

framework_mappings.title: Security in network and information systems acquisition, development and maintenance, including vulnerability handling and disclosure

incident_response.description: Assessment of whether an incident-response plan exists, defines responsibilities, includes communication and reporting procedures and is periodically tested.
incident_response.assessment_scope: The assessment focuses on incident-response planning, assigned roles, communication, reporting and testing within NIS2 Article 21(2)(b). It does not assess the complete operational incident-management lifecycle.

framework_mappings.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
